spec.source:
---
config:
  er:
    rankSpacing: 40
    nodeSpacing: 30
---
erDiagram
  ROUTE ||--o{ TRIP : "route_id"
  TRIP ||--|{ STOP_TIME : "trip_id"
  STOP |o--o{ STOP_TIME : "stop_id"
  TRIP ||--o{ FREQUENCY : "trip_id"
  CALENDAR |o--o{ TRIP : "service_id"
  CALENDAR_DATE }o--o{ TRIP : "service_id"
  ROUTE {
    id route_id
    text route_short_name
  }
  TRIP {
    id trip_id
    id route_id
    id service_id
  }
  STOP_TIME {
    id trip_id
    int stop_sequence
    id stop_id
    time departure_time
  }
  STOP {
    id stop_id
    text stop_name
  }
  FREQUENCY {
    id trip_id
    time start_time
    time end_time
    int headway_secs
  }
  CALENDAR {
    id service_id
    enum monday
    enum tuesday
    enum wednesday
    enum thursday
    enum friday
    enum saturday
    enum sunday
    date start_date
    date end_date
  }
  CALENDAR_DATE {
    id service_id
    date date
    enum exception_type
  }
